name: ps3-turns-20
lines:
في 17 نوفمبر 2006 بدأ بيع
جهاز PS3 في أمريكا الشمالية

بدأ السعر من 499 دولارًا
لنسخة 20 غيغابايت

كانت Resistance: Fall of Man
من ألعاب الإطلاق

وفق موقع بلايستيشن، تجاوزت
مبيعات PS3 87 مليون جهاز
headline:
قبل 20 عامًا
صدرت PlayStation 3
label: في مثل هذا اليوم

tried: PlayStation.com PS3 start-up clip (10.9 s, 1080p, a TV on a white ground: a 9:16 crop enlarges about 3x and cuts the logo; the showcase layout is not built in reel.py)
PS3-era game trailers (YouTube only, not fetchable)
Sony Interactive press images (spec tables only)

lowres_ok.result: the Resistance: Fall of Man box art is 592x840 and the largest official copy found (2.3x in the 9:16 frame); the other four images fill 9:16 at under 2x

reel_check.SOURCE primary read: yes: SCEA release 17 Nov 2006 and 19 Oct 2006 (Sony mediaroom), PlayStation.com PS3 history page, SCEI releases 8 May, 22 Sep, 3 Oct 2006 (Sony Interactive); gate 8 Nov 2026 in the story file
reel_check.SOURCE not already posted: yes: ledger find recorded, 0 hits; main session checks Publer 7 days
reel_check.SOURCE age: yes: anniversary dated by 17 Nov 2026 itself
reel_check.ANGLE hook/why now/players/payoff: yes: hook the console that launched 20 years ago; why now 20th anniversary of the NA launch; players: price and the launch game; payoff: over 87 million sold per PlayStation's own page
reel_check.STORY TYPE items: yes: anniversary: date and place, price, launch title, later sales, each with its Sony source
reel_check.STORY one spoken paragraph: yes: sales began on 17 Nov 2006 in North America; the price started at $499 for the 20 GB model; Resistance: Fall of Man was a launch game; PlayStation's site says it passed 87 million
reel_check.STORY subject before pronoun, no line on: yes: PS3 is in the headline and line 1; lines open on في, بدأ, كانت, وفق
reel_check.STORY release verbs: yes: بدأ بيع, صدرت in the headline; no bare تصل
reel_check.STORY names: yes: سوني and بلايستيشن follow names-ar; no new names
reel_check.WRITING headline/lines/caption/X/Threads: yes: drafts in the story file; game and news word in the first five words; no hashtags on X; IG ends #ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #PlayStation3 #PS3
reel_check.SOUND footage's own sound: n/a: official stills, our bed (stills Reel, nothing has sound of its own); the PS3 start-up clip's sound was not usable without its picture
reel_check.PICTURE footage first: yes: no usable official footage: stills_reason lists the footage tried
reel_check.PICTURE not same as last five: yes: picture: PS3 hardware and box art, no PS3 Reel before
reel_check.PICTURE vertical, nothing graphic: yes: product images cropped to the vertical window; nothing graphic
reel_check.PICTURE credit: yes: one credit over shots 0 to 8
reel_check.CHECKS: yes: what I see: the PS3 console, the red launch advert, the XMB and the Resistance box; what I hear: our bed
